Ragweed or daisy allergies can also cause reactions.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXtuOiLd7ulRdfW0qTEYUaUZjBxbJBBZA_fwoDe44BaF_oCyop-wRzOy-wIFWm88Ab--cfBn04bhx7n4Rwa5jdvzp-P9bLAqxsABj4VzlXlG2su_K0sGBolqfe-ECGR0Fb8jwXMAo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF19sYOvAPrx8USwDy9l2tQSwCzhl-Nye7THMZlUvOxvsy5IFPuw7wsgkeGOunSt3mz7o5wsf4t-6XdFFbBJa7hU1nJrHCUFydCZnVbUICq94eocRjG3259jfLiDJo-0IcB19Uq58e-48XdLiQCdstN_PAHqrJh6RV_ZZA-UY)
